meta.title: Classic Honeypot for CF7 - development site
meta.author: nilovelez
meta.description: Contact Form 7 plus a test page with a [honeypot] form. The plugin itself is mounted from the repository, not installed by this blueprint.

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Idempotent: the persisted site may run this blueprint more than once.
if ( get_page_by_path( 'honeypot-test' ) ) {
	return;
}

$form       = WPCF7_ContactForm::get_template( array( 'title' => 'Honeypot test' ) );
$properties = $form->get_properties();

$properties['form'] = str_replace( '[submit', "[honeypot honeypot-field]\n\n[submit", $properties['form'] );

// Playground cannot send email: let CF7 report success without mailing.
$properties['additional_settings'] = 'skip_mail: on';

$form->set_properties( $properties );
$form->save();

wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_name'    => 'honeypot-test',
		'post_title'   => 'Honeypot test',
		'post_content' => sprintf( '[contact-form-7 id="%s" title="Honeypot test"]', $form->hash() ),
	)
);
